description: Find which devices are connected to the user's machine through a relay: sends the MIDI Identity Request (F0 7E 7F 06 01 F7, changes nothing on the device) to every output and matches the answers — manufacturer, model, firmware version — against the drivers' identity blocks. With maker_requests, also sends the makers' own identity requests the drivers name (they change nothing either, but the relay asks the user to accept them, once per output: tell the user first), which recognise devices that ignore the universal one. Returns the best driver ids (recognised_by and firmware when an identity block recognised the device) and identity_hex to pass to report_result. A device that does not answer is found by its knobs with listen_ms (by_controls), or by what people confirmed of its port name (learned); when several remain, ask names the control to have the user turn next (expect: what each candidate would send), then call again with listen_ms.

code.description: The pairing code the relay page or program shows (e.g. 'K7QM-2XPA').

listen_ms.description: Listen this long for a device that does not answer: ask the user first to turn three or four of its knobs during that time; the controls they send are matched against every driver (by_controls). Confirm the device with the user, then send its fingerprint to POST /v1/fingerprints so the next detection knows it.

maker_requests.description: Also send the makers' identity requests, after the user accepts them at the relay (default false).

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for answers (default 1000).

user_id.description: Your anonymous SynthHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: relay_detect
